test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

E25I : A5E :: Z49T : V7P :: P144K : ?
solution:
Explanation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e82b7da6e41b2a069e2db44b7b686c69a4d8afae6d389dc05a659aaeaa56953.png] 

The pattern followed here is: (Second number)² = First number

E25I : A5E → (5)² = 25

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/855798763ec051545e6a3e3622841fb01450f6ff902c2add47a35d837800002c.png] 

And

 Z49T : V7P → (7)² =49

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd236b40da17dee5ba833d364d286de19f0d8aa0f46a105a206f92fec80269ed.png] 

Similarly,

 P144K : L12G → (12)² = 144

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e17de2e3b0a07c7425c10630a1343ec8722ec9404d4d8935e6b8a7e755114bf7.png] 

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.
